boundary: The base physical/ninjutsu damage candidates and ordinary per-hit success gate are closed. Status modifiers, facing/terrain special cases, critical and ignore-defense trigger probabilities, linked attacks, healing, and non-damage effect formulas still require separate bindings.
conclusion: The queued attack stores four integer damage candidates before animation. The natural three-hit sample queues normal defended damage 9 and resolves 18 total damage, which uniquely requires two normal hits and one miss; the visible template value 6x3 is not final damage.
method: Validate the original-ROM event-builder and per-hit RNG instructions, then recompute all four queued damage candidates from a natural three-hit ninja-tool checkpoint and require the resolved HP delta to have a unique outcome composition.
